lines.text: Karim and Sami. Same gym, same plan. Only Karim takes creatine.
Week one, Karim is up a kilo and a half. Not fat. Water, pulled into his muscles.
Weeks later? Across twenty-two studies, creatine lifters gained twenty percent strength. Without it, twelve. Plus more reps.
Sami's excuse: it makes you bald. That's one small study. It never even measured hair.
Exam night, no sleep? In a 2024 study, one dose helped memory and thinking.
Three to five grams a day. Every day.
Creatine helps. Your plan does the work. Darebni AI.
